About Aadarsh Engineering

Aadarsh Engineering is an engineering and maintenance services business offering students practical industry exposure in business analysis, marketing, sales, business development and strategic planning.

We are looking for motivated postgraduate students who want to apply their academic knowledge in a real engineering business environment and develop a long-term professional career.

1. Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from students who:

* ***Have completed at one year of a Master's degree.***
* Are currently studying Business Analytics, Business Administration, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Management or a related qualification.
* Have an interest in business analysis, marketing and business development.
* Have good analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Are interested in gaining practical industry experience.
* Can attend our workplace in person.
* Are interested in progressing towards paid employment based on their suitability and performance.

2. Internship / Work Experience Program- pathway

**Initial Internship Opportunity**

* Duration: 120 hours. in person to understand business requirements .
* Commitment: Approximately 6 to 12 hours per week in office .
* Working arrangement: Onsite / In-person.
* Focus: Working with Team for understanding business requirements and apply your learning tools to build your confidence to working industry .
* Structured learning, industry exposure and supervised skill development.

***3. Key Responsibilities & Learning Areas***

**A. Business Analysis**

* Research engineering industry trends and market opportunities.
* Analyse business performance and customer requirements.
* Conduct competitor and market research.
* Assist with business reports and management presentations.
* Identify opportunities for business improvement.
* Analyse customer enquiries and potential business leads.
* Support business planning and strategic development.

**B. Marketing & Digital Marketing**

* Develop marketing strategies for engineering services.
* Manage social media marketing and business promotion.
* Assist with LinkedIn marketing and professional networking.
* Support website content and SEO activities.
* Prepare marketing campaigns and promotional materials.
* Monitor marketing performance and lead generation.

**C. Sales & Business Development**

* Research potential industrial customers.
* Identify new business opportunities.
* Assist with customer relationship management.
* Support preparation of quotations and sales proposals.
* Follow up customer enquiries under supervision.
* Develop B2B sales and communication skills.

**D. Business Operations & Reporting**

* Understand engineering and maintenance business operations.
* Assist with business documentation and reporting.
* Learn project coordination and administrative processes.
* Prepare presentations and business development reports.

4. Career Progression – Our Employment Pathway

*We believe in developing talent internally and creating long-term career opportunities for students.*

**Stage 1 – Internship / Work Experience**

* Up to 120 hours.
* Approximately 6 hours per week.
* Structured learning and supervised practical experience.

**Stage 2 – Paid Part-time Employment**

* Candidates who successfully complete the initial program may be considered for a paid part-time position.
* Work will involve business analysis, marketing and business development activities.
* Employment will be subject to a separate paid employment agreement.

**Stage 3 – Full-time Employment Opportunity**

* After successfully completing their Master's degree, suitable candidates may be considered for full-time employment.
* Progression will depend on performance, qualifications, professional development and business requirements.

**Our vision is to develop students into future Business Analysts, Marketing Professionals and Business Development Managers within Aadarsh Engineering.**

5. Skills & Qualities We Value

* Analytical and critical-thinking ability.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Research and data analysis skills.
* Digital marketing knowledge.
* Business development interest.
* Initiative and problem-solving ability.
* Professional attitude and teamwork.
* Willingness to learn about the engineering industry.

6. How to Apply

Interested students should submit:

* Updated resume / CV.
* Current Master's qualification and academic details.
* A short introduction explaining their interest in business analysis and marketing.
* Relevant skills in analytics, marketing or business development.
* Availability for approximately 6 hours per week onsite.

Join us to gain practical engineering business exposure, develop professional skills and build a pathway towards long-term employment.

**Aadarsh Engineering**  
*Learn • Analyse • Develop • Perform • Grow With Us*

About Greenwood Academy

Greenwood Academy of Animal Care and Agriculture is a Registered Training Organisation (RTO) specialising in vocational education and training for the animal care industry.

We deliver nationally recognised qualifications in animal care, pet grooming and veterinary nursing across our Sydney and Melbourne campuses.

Our focus is on developing job-ready graduates equipped with practical industry skills, professional knowledge and a strong commitment to animal welfare.

We are seeking an organised, proactive and industry-focused Work Placement Coordinator to oversee and coordinate student work placements across both campuses.

About the Role

This is a key coordination role responsible for managing the end-to-end work placement process for students enrolled in our animal care, pet grooming and veterinary nursing courses.

Working closely with students, trainers, employers and veterinary and animal care industry partners, you will ensure students are successfully placed in suitable workplace environments and receive appropriate support throughout their placement journey.

You will be responsible for coordinating placement activities across both Sydney and Melbourne campuses, maintaining industry partnerships, monitoring student progress and ensuring accurate placement records and documentation.

This role requires someone who is comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities and communicating with a diverse range of stakeholders across multiple locations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Work Placement Coordination**

* Coordinate and allocate student work placements across Sydney and Melbourne campuses.
* Identify, establish and maintain relationships with veterinary hospitals, veterinary clinics, animal shelters, pet grooming salons, boarding facilities and other relevant industry partners.
* Source and secure suitable placement opportunities to meet student training and assessment requirements.
* Match students with appropriate placement providers based on course requirements, location, availability and workplace suitability.
* Coordinate placement schedules, commencement dates, attendance and required placement hours.
* Monitor placement capacity and proactively identify additional industry partners to support student enrolments.

**2. Student Support and Communication**

* Act as the primary point of contact for students regarding work placement arrangements.
* Guide students through placement requirements, application processes and workplace expectations.
* Follow up with students and placement providers to monitor attendance, progress and completion of placement hours.
* Assist with resolving placement-related issues and escalate concerns where appropriate.
* Maintain regular communication with students to ensure timely completion of placement requirements.

**3. Industry and Employer Relationships**

* Develop and maintain positive working relationships with industry partners.
* Communicate with placement supervisors to ensure students receive appropriate workplace exposure and supervision.
* Conduct placement site suitability checks and maintain relevant employer and workplace records.
* Gather feedback from industry partners to support continuous improvement of our placement arrangements.
* Identify opportunities to expand Greenwood Academy's industry network and placement capacity.

**4. Administration and Compliance**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date placement records for all students across both campuses.
* Monitor student placement hours and ensure required documentation is completed and submitted.
* Coordinate placement agreements, workplace induction documentation, insurance records and other relevant compliance documents.
* Ensure placement arrangements align with course requirements, RTO obligations and applicable workplace health and safety requirements.
* Provide regular placement status updates and reports to management and academic staff.

About You

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, resourceful and enjoys working with people in the animal care industry.

You will ideally have:

* Experience in work placement coordination, student services, education administration or a similar coordination role.
* Experience or familiarity with the veterinary, animal care, pet grooming or animal welfare industries.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with students, employers and industry professionals.
* Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple placement arrangements across different locations.
* Strong administrative skills and attention to detail, particularly in maintaining records and tracking placement progress.
* Confidence working independently, taking initiative and following through on outstanding tasks.
* Good problem-solving skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Competent computer skills, including Microsoft Office and online student management systems.

**Desirable:**

* Previous experience working in a veterinary hospital, veterinary clinic, animal care facility or pet grooming business.
* Veterinary nursing, animal care or related industry qualifications.
* Familiarity with the Australian VET sector, RTO compliance requirements and student work placement arrangements.
* Experience coordinating placements across multiple campuses or locations.

Why Join Greenwood Academy?

* Be part of a growing vocational education provider in the animal care industry.
* Work closely with veterinary and animal care professionals and industry partners.
* Play an important role in helping students transition from education into employment.
* Opportunity to contribute to the development and expansion of our industry placement network.
* A varied and engaging role with responsibility across two campuses.

How to Apply

If you are passionate about the animal care industry, enjoy building professional relationships and have the organisational skills to coordinate student placements across multiple locations, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and suitability for the role.

**About Syenta**  
Syenta is pioneering a new era in semiconductor manufacturing with our groundbreaking Localized Electrochemical Manufacturing (LEM) technology. Our manufacturing products build cutting edge advanced packaging for the semiconductor industry by combining patterning and metallization into a single tool. We do that by achieving high-speed, high-resolution metallization at significantly lower costs and energy use, while minimizing emissions and waste.

Founded in Australia, our growing footprint in the US represents a key milestone in our journey. We are building a world-class team where seasoned engineers and ambitious emerging talent collaborate to solve some of the toughest challenges in semiconductor manufacturing.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Metrology Technician to join our growing team. This entry-level position offers a clear progression path to develop into a metrology expert as our capabilities expand.

You will be tasked with measuring, inspecting, and characterizing semiconductor wafers, microfabricated stamps, and precision features using advanced metrology equipment.

Collaborating closely with our engineering and process development teams, you will help ensure that measurements are accurate, repeatable, and delivered promptly to support technical decisions.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with precision equipment, solving practical problems, and taking ownership of their work.

**What You'll Do**

* Measurement & Inspection: Perform dimensional, surface, and defect measurements on semiconductor wafers, stamps, and microfabricated structures.
* Equipment Operation: Operate optical microscopes, profilometers, scanning electron microscopes (SEM), and other precision measurement equipment.
* Data Collection & Reporting: Accurately record, organize, and communicate measurement results, identifying anomalies and trends.
* Process Development Support: Work with engineers to characterize experimental samples, validate process performance, and investigate defects.
* Equipment Readiness: Conduct routine equipment checks, calibration verification, basic troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.
* Continuous Improvement: Assist with developing and improving measurement procedures, inspection workflows, and equipment usage.
* Cleanroom Operations: Safely handle sensitive samples and equipment while following cleanroom protocols and contamination control requirements.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in chemistry, engineering, materials science, physics, electronics, or a related discipline, or progressing towards graduating in one of these areas.
* Practical experience in metrology, microscopy, laboratory testing, precision manufacturing, semiconductor processing, or a related technical field.
* Confidence in operating, maintaining, or troubleshooting technical equipment.
* Strong attention to detail and knowledge of measurement accuracy and repeatability.
* Ability to record and interpret technical data and clearly communicate findings.
* A proactive, hands-on approach to solving problems.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results efficiently.
* Willingness to learn new equipment, processes, and techniques.

**Highly Regarded, But Not Essential**

* Experience with optical profilometry, stylus profilometry, SEM, or automated inspection systems.
* Experience handling semiconductor wafers or working in a cleanroom environment.
* Familiarity with surface roughness, feature dimensions, film thickness, or defect inspection.
* Experience with measurement software, image analysis, or statistical process control.

**Why Choose Syenta?**

We’re passionate about building a diverse, people-first company. Our culture of collaboration and mutual respect fuels innovation capable of redefining an industry. At Syenta, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, lead high-impact teams, and shape the future of semiconductor manufacturing.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Early-stage equity opportunities
* 12% superannuation contributions
* Flexible leave policies and a strong work-life balance
* Professional growth in a high-impact, fast-growing deep-tech startup
* Team events and collaborative culture, including company-wide gatherings in Australia

**About the Department**
------------------------

The Department of Industry, Science and Resources and our broader portfolio are integral to the Australian Government’s economic agenda. * Growing innovative & competitive businesses, industries and regions

Please see the APSC’s APS Employee Value Proposition for more information on the benefits and value of employment within the APS.  

**About the team**
------------------

The Temperature and Humidity Team maintains and disseminates Australia’s primary standards for temperature, humidity and trace moisture measurement. We deliver high-accuracy calibration and measurement services to Australian industry, government and research organisations in sectors including advanced manufacturing, semiconductor processing, pharmaceuticals, defence and aerospace, clean energy including hydrogen. The team operates specialised humidity generation and measurement facilities covering relative humidity, dew-point and frost-point temperature, and trace moisture in gases. We work within an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited quality system and undertake research and capability development to improve Australia’s national measurement infrastructure.

**The opportunity**
-------------------

Start or build your scientific or engineering career at Australia’s national measurement authority. With structured training and support from experienced scientists and engineers, you will develop specialist capability in precision temperature and humidity measurement while contributing to nationally significant calibration services and Australia’s primary measurement standards.

**What’s in it for you?**
-------------------------

Join a community of professionals committed to technical measurement excellence and cutting-edge research. We invest in advanced facilities, foster collaboration with leading institutions and support innovation. You will work with people who have diverse skill sets including scientists, engineers, policy specialists and regulatory professionals.  
  
This role provides an excellent opportunity to develop specialist expertise in humidity metrology while working with advanced humidity generation and high-accuracy reference measurement systems. You will build strong capabilities in measurement uncertainty, metrological traceability and laboratory quality systems within an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited environment, while contributing to the design, automation, validation and commissioning of new national measurement capabilities. Working alongside experienced scientists, engineers and metrologists, you will apply your technical skills to solve real-world measurement challenges for Australian industry and research organisations, participate in applied research projects, and progress towards becoming an authorised signatory and recognised technical specialist in humidity measurement.

* Parental leave.

* Hold a tertiary qualification in physics, chemistry, engineering or a related discipline.
* Demonstrate ability to apply your scientific and analytical expertise to solve practical problems.
* Have a curious mindset and ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.
* Have experience with identifying and resolving problems with equipment and instrumentation.
* Demonstrate sound judgement, initiative and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Be organised, adaptable and able to manage competing priorities.
* Communicate effectively and work collaboratively with colleagues, clients and stakeholders.

We are looking for individuals who bring personal integrity and a sense of purpose, and who embody NMI's values of being Inclusive, Innovative, Accountable, Adaptable, Influential and Strategic.  
  
Our department has a commitment to inclusion and diversity, with an ambition of being the best possible place to work. This reflects the importance we place on our people and on creating a workplace culture where each and every one of us is valued and respected for our contribution. Our ideal candidate adds to this culture and our workplace in their own way.
